create.title: Actual ratio-symbol and two-step square-root energy involution
create.statement_tex: In the fixed smooth positive-ratio interior, the normalized square-root-product row is P_k=sum_(q odd) chi_4(q) C(k/q)e(sqrt(Xkq)), where C(y)=y^(3/4)Xi(2sqrt(y)) has bounded logarithmic derivatives and a Schwartz Mellin transform. Expanding |P_k|^2, writing q_1=q+2d, and applying stationary Poisson/B-process first in d and then on the odd q-lattice gives the following exact stationary-main involution: the first saddle is q_1^*=4Xk/j^2 with odd j, square phase (sqrt(Xk/j)-sqrt(jq)/2)^2, and amplitude sqrt(k/J)Xi(j/J); the second saddle is q^*=4Xk/s^2 with odd s, phase Xk(1/j-1/s), and amplitude sqrt(k/J)conj(Xi(s/J)). The Gaussian units cancel, the odd-lattice density is 1/2, and (-1)^((j-s)/2)=chi_4(j)chi_4(s), so the complete two-step stationary main is (k/J)|S_k|^2. This is a return map, not an estimate. Every fixed nonzero half-integral difference shell is O(Q^2), and exact product-square fibers have O(Q^(3/2+epsilon)) unsigned pairs, but the signed union of O(Q) shells and the complete twice-transformed nonstationary/transition/error ledger remain open.

reject.reason: A smooth phase-conjugating coefficient can make the energy Q^3. The actual ratio symbol excludes that countermodel, but no theorem uniform over arbitrary moving coefficients is possible.
Two successive stationary B-processes restore exactly (k/J)|S_k|^2, including both characters, Gaussian units, and the odd-lattice half-density; the route is involutive rather than saving.
After lawful Mellin separation of the actual ratio symbol, the audited root-spacing/double-large-sieve route gives only Q^2 X^(1/4+epsilon), which is worse than the required Q^2 X^epsilon.
Each fixed nonzero half-integral difference shell is O(Q^2), but there are O(Q) shells and no proved cancellation across their signed union.
Exact product-square fibers have only O(Q^(3/2+epsilon)) unsigned pairs and fourth-power fibers are smaller, so they lie below the Q^2 diagonal scale under the actual bounded symbol.

no_change.reason: The signed union of difference shells, full fixed-sector error ledger, lower radial sectors, and endpoint completion remain open.
Round 68 proves an exact symbol and a circular reduction, not the conjectural exponent.
